Home / Gantt
Display Views — Gantt

Gantt — Parent and child tasks, laid out over time.

A hierarchical tree and timeline together visualize durations, dependencies, and progress. Just drag a bar to adjust the schedule.

Hierarchical Tree + Timeline

Visualizes timelines while preserving parent-child task structure. Hiding completed tasks is supported too

Drag the bar to change the schedule

Change start and due dates directly by dragging. Reflected in Backlog instantly. Automatic schedule shifting for dependent downstream tasks runs with confirmation too

The lightning line shows progress at a glance

A lightning line connects each task's progress line, so you can spot delays or being ahead instantly

Dependencies & Critical Path

Predecessor-to-successor dependencies are visualized with arrows. Delay warnings and critical-path highlighting included

Milestones (◆), progress roll-up, and fast rendering

Visualizes milestone deadlines and shows child-task completion rates on parent tasks. Virtual scrolling keeps even large projects running smoothly

Adjust schedules right on the spot.

Drag the bar to change the due date, and downstream tasks shift automatically — all right within the Gantt view.
